title: mrobaczyk/civ6 - Civilization VI xml/sql/lua/txt files across updates (repository and commit history)
author_org: GitHub user mrobaczyk (third-party mirror of Firaxis-authored files)
claims_supported: Per-update snapshots of the shipped base-game and DLC-pack data exist from the 2016-10-20 initial release to the 2024-07-15 update (commit titles name each update and date)
The mirror does NOT contain the Rise and Fall (Expansion1) or Gathering Storm (Expansion2) ruleset data folders
notes: Commit history read with WebFetch (https://github.com/mrobaczyk/civ6/commits/main and .../commits/7fd9364da8b4ea893cb668a68207682b1836f207). Commit titles are the uploader's labels; the 2020-08-27 label matches the official patch-note date in CIV-27. Mirror fidelity not independently verified; values read from it are cited as game data (CIV-02..CIV-22) with this caveat. Proprietary files: facts extracted only, nothing copied.

title: Civilization VI base ruleset data: Base/Assets/Gameplay/Data/Technologies.xml (release and update snapshots)
author_org: Firaxis Games (game data), via CIV-01 mirror
claims_supported: 68 technologies in the base ruleset at release and in the 2024-07-15 snapshot; Future Tech is repeatable from release
64 technology boost rows, every one with Boost=50 (50% of cost), unchanged in all 25 sampled base-ruleset snapshots 2016-10-20..2024-07-15
No boost row for Animal Husbandry, Mining, Pottery, Future Tech
Boost trigger classes enumerated in a BoostNames table: 56 at release, 62 in the latest snapshot
Cross-tree boosts: Stirrups, Banking, Scientific Theory and Robotics are boosted by completing a named civic (Feudalism, Guilds, The Enlightenment, Globalization)
Six late-game techs (Rocketry, Nuclear Fission, Satellites, Lasers, Stealth Technology, Nuclear Fusion) carry a boost row whose trigger is only obtainable by a Great Scientist or a spy
Exposure-type triggers: Writing boosted by meeting another civilization; Currency by a trade route; Chemistry by having a research agreement
Tech costs 25..2500; era medians 50/160/390/540/907.5/1250/1410/1850 (Ancient..Information); 90 prerequisite edges, max 4 prerequisites, 5 root techs
A data comment states some boost rows carry a unit field only as a hint for the AI
notes: Downloaded raw at aec7461 and 310319f, plus the 25 snapshot SHAs listed in CIV-01, from raw.githubusercontent.com; counts computed locally. Base ruleset only - R&F/GS rulesets override these values in expansion files that were not retrievable.

Foreign Trade boosted by discovering another continent; Medieval Faires by maintaining trade routes; Political Philosophy by meeting city-states

title: Civilization VI base ruleset data: Base/Assets/Gameplay/Data/GlobalParameters.xml
author_org: Firaxis Games (game data), via CIV-01 mirror
claims_supported: Science per citizen 70% and culture per citizen 30% of a point (same at release)
Population-per-district parameter DISTRICT_POPULATION_REQUIRED_PER = 3 (limits districts per city)
Strategic resource minimum for unit production: 2 anywhere, 1 with the district (base ruleset; no per-unit consumption parameters)
Research agreement parameter of 10 percent; government base anarchy 2 turns; policy-change cost parameters exist
Unit experience parameters: max 10 XP per combat, 10 XP for revealing a natural wonder, 5 XP for a tribal village, max level 6
No parameter for a tech-cost reduction based on other civilizations knowing a technology was found among the base parameters
notes: Raw downloads at aec7461 and 310319f; the last claim is an absence-of-evidence reading of data-exposed parameters only (engine code is closed).

title: Civilization VI in-game Civilopedia concepts text (Base/Assets/Text/en_US/Civilopedia_Concepts_Text.xml)
author_org: Firaxis Games (in-game text), via CIV-01 mirror
claims_supported: Science accrues to a pool each turn; citizens give 0.7 Science each; the technology tree auto-plots the quickest route to a selected distant technology and queues its prerequisites (same for civics)
Boosts can also come from Great People, research agreements and team-shared research
Culture advances the civics tree, which unlocks policies, governments and some buildings, districts and diplomatic options

Diplomatic Visibility has five levels per civilization, gained from trade routes, delegations or embassies, a spy listening post, alliances, researching Printing, and one leader ability; higher levels reveal more gossip (from declarations and wonders up to opinions, government and agendas)
Spies arrive in the Renaissance; each civilization can have 5 (6 for Catherine); missions include stealing technology boosts
Ranged attacks need line of sight: mountains block it; units on hills or flying can see over obstructions
The civics text describes the Culture pool as emptied when a civic completes and does not mention overflow
notes: Raw download at 310319f; base-game text, may differ under expansions. Paraphrased; nothing copied beyond short identifiers.

title: beyond-the-sword-sdk: unedited CvGameCoreDLL sources for Civilization IV: Beyond the Sword (CvPlayer.cpp, CvTeam.cpp, CvPlayerAI.cpp, CvPlot.cpp)
author_org: Firaxis Games (SDK source), mirrored by GitHub user dguenms
claims_supported: Research rate modifier adds TECH_COST_TOTAL_KNOWN_TEAM_MODIFIER times (living teams that we have met and that know the tech) divided by (all living teams), plus TECH_COST_KNOWN_PREREQ_MODIFIER per known alternative prerequisite
Research beyond a technology's cost becomes overflow carried into the next technology (normalised by the research modifier); with no research target the turn's research is stored as overflow

AI city-site values are computed only for plots revealed to the AI's team (all other plots keep a no-value marker), and resources are filtered by the team's reveal technology (an unrevealed resource reads as none); only starting-location placement uses unfiltered data
notes: Raw downloads of CvGameCoreDLL/CvPlayer.cpp (calculateResearchModifier, turn research loop), CvTeam.cpp (setResearchProgress), CvPlayerAI.cpp (AI_updateFoundValues, AI_foundValue) and CvPlot.cpp (getBonusType) from master. Repository describes itself as unedited SDK sources.
